findings.title: Mobile CLS — fixed same day, re-verified
findings.description: Real Lighthouse initially showed CLS 0.165-0.183 (Needs Improvement), caused by a self-inflicted regression: lazy-loading fonts.css (part of the initial render-blocking-CSS fix) broke the site's metric-matched fallback-font system, which needs to be available at first paint. Reverted fonts.css to blocking, kept only rewards.css lazy. Re-verified against production with a fresh PSI run: CLS now 0.074 (Good, under the 0.1 threshold).
findings.recommendation: None further needed. Keep fonts.css blocking if touching CSS loading strategy again.

findings.title: CrUX field data unavailable
findings.description: CrUX (both per-URL and origin-level) returned 'Insufficient Chrome traffic volume for eligibility'. Google API credentials are correctly configured (Tier 1); this is a traffic-volume ceiling for a young/low-traffic site, not a configuration or code defect.
findings.recommendation: Re-check CrUX eligibility in 2-3 months as organic traffic grows.

findings.title: Render-blocking CSS impacts LCP
findings.description: 4 render-blocking stylesheets remain (tokens.css, [page].css, utilities.css, fonts.css); only rewards.css is lazy-loaded via js/lazy-css.js (fonts.css was reverted to blocking after it caused a CLS regression, commit 802d9e6). Lab LCP is already Good (1.7s mobile) and CLS is now Good (0.074) post-fix.
findings.recommendation: Optional further optimization: inline critical CSS for tokens.css if squeezing more mobile LCP margin is desired.
